summary.text: Mary Gonzalez is a Democratic state representative from Texas House District 75 who has represented the district since 2013 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Mary Gonzalez earned a B.S. in history and Mexican American studies from the University of Texas at Austin and an M.S. in liberal arts and social justice from St. Edward's University in 2009.

Her professional experience includes working as assistant director of the Office of Research and Demonstration for the National Hispanic Institute, assistant dean of student multicultural affairs and visiting instructor at Southwestern University, and program coordinator of the Multicultural Engagement Center at the University of Texas at Austin.
Gonzalez took office in the Texas House in 2013.
Ballotpedia lists her 2021-2022 committee assignments as Appropriations (as vice chair) and Public Education.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on March 3, 2026.
